Package com.longbridge.asset

Class BankCardAuthorization

  • java.lang.Object
    • com.longbridge.asset.BankCardAuthorization
  • public class BankCardAuthorization
extends Object
    An authorization attached to a bank card (eDDA, bank securities account, FPS, ...)

      String getCurrency()
      Returns the authorized currency.
      Long getDailyMaxCount()
      Returns the maximum number of debits per day (null when not set).
      OffsetDateTime getExpiryDate()
      Returns the expiry date (null when not set and for a long-term authorization: the server's 9999-12-31 "never expires" sentinel is null; see isLongTermValid()).
      String getFlowId()
      Returns the authorization flow: hk_edda / hk_sdda (eDDA), hk_bank_sec, hk_fps, ....

      Returns the maximum amount per debit (null when not set).

      Returns the failure reason (empty unless the authorization failed).

      Returns the display name of the authorization.

      Returns the authorization status.

      boolean isDailyMaxCountUnlimited()
      Returns whether the daily debit count is unlimited.

      Returns whether the authorization never expires.

      Returns whether the per-debit amount is unlimited.

      Returns whether the "no prior deposit" check is under review.
